title: No stable user id in events
problem: events only has session_id, which changes with every tab/session and exists only with cookie consent. We cannot tell who comes back or what a user does over time.
dependsOn: a stable pseudonymous user id in events for logged-in users (#1). No external dependency; it touches the product beacon, so it goes through a PR.

title: «Analysis» neither defined nor tracked per user
problem: The activation North Star talks about analyses, but there is no written definition. Today only card_open exists, and it is anonymous (no user).
dependsOn: G01 + a written definition of «analysis» (Steve) + an analysis_viewed event (#2) in the product's event allowlist (lib/analytics-events.ts).

title: Revenue without usable amounts
problem: events.value is always 0. Stripe stores no amounts in the DB. Shopify has the amounts but not normalized by period and currency. MRR and ARPU do not exist today.
dependsOn: revenue module (#4): amount, period and currency for every subscription, from every channel. Shopify stores the amount today but not the store currency.

title: Watchlist only in the browser, no user alerts
problem: The watchlist lives in localStorage and generates no events. The user alert feature does not exist.

title: ?src= tags not rolled out on the channels
problem: The IG, TikTok, X, Reddit, email and creator links do not carry a consistent ?src=. There is no ready «organic» segment. Search Console is not integrated. In the Oct 5 snapshot (30 days), 387 sessions out of 400 show as «(no source)».
owner: Steve (tags on the channels) + Calde (Search Console)
dependsOn: ?src= tags on the channel links (Steve) + access to Search Console (see Access and sources) for the organic part.

title: CAC: no marketing spend per channel
problem: How much we spend per channel is not recorded anywhere: ads, creators, affiliates.

title: Affiliate revenue: clicks only
problem: We record partner_click, but conversions and commissions sit on the affiliate networks' portals and never reach the DB.

title: Churn without history
problem: The cron downgrades expired subscriptions but does not record the history. The paying base at the start of the period is missing, so there is only the count of expiries (PROXY).
dependsOn: churn log: a historical table of subscription states (activated, renewed, expired, refunded) written by the subscriptions cron and by the payment webhooks. It is a migration on the production DB: PROPOSAL + APPROVE by Andrea.

title: Uptime and odds latency not measured, operational alerts silent
problem: No external monitor records the availability history. We only have the age of the last odds, not the delay against the bookmaker. Without ALERT_WEBHOOK_URL the operational alerts reach nobody.
dependsOn: latency measurement: the odds collector has to store the odds timestamp at the source (bookmaker/API) next to captured_at. For uptime: an external monitor with history.

title: Tracking accuracy not verified
problem: No job compares events with the external sources. Data gets lost without anyone noticing: rate limits, the event allowlist, consent. Between 36% and 56% of page_views have no session.
unlocks: Trust in every KPI from events

title: No trial in the product
problem: The product has no trial, so the trial→paid conversion is not part of the KPIs.

title: Paying count polluted by comp/team accounts
problem: Profiles on a paid plan include accounts granted by hand (manual, referral), team accounts and test accounts: on Oct 7, 3 of the 4 «verified paying» were our own accounts and none had an external payment recorded. Since v7 the dashboard counts «External paying customers» excluding the list of ids in content/internal-accounts.json (generated locally, to be regenerated when a team account is created) and the plans without any paid order. It stays manual: the product does not flag internal accounts.

title: Sessions without consent not counted
problem: Without cookie consent the beacon fires without a session_id, so those visits do not become sessions. Oct 6 snapshot: 440 page_views out of 625 without a session in the last 7 days (70%), 1,459 out of 3,201 in the last 30 (46%). Vercel Web Analytics does not fill the hole: it also loads only with consent (components/VercelAnalytics.tsx).
dependsOn: a server-side count of sessions without cookies (e.g. a non-persistent daily hash), only after legale-compliance's opinion on ePrivacy/GDPR. For the organic part alone, Search Console clicks are an independent check that does not depend on consent.

title: No internal flag in the product: team traffic cannot be separated
problem: Events do not say whether a visit, a click or a signup comes from us. The Oct 7 audit estimates that a large part of the sessions, opened cards and partner clicks is the team's, but the estimate is based on country, which is not an accepted criterion for excluding traffic. Today the dashboard can only warn («Don't trust») and exclude the explicit test sources (pr-check, qa, localhost…), not the team.
dependsOn: an internal flag set by the product for team accounts (e.g. a cookie or a meta.internal field on the beacon when the logged-in user is in the internal list) and written to events; for logged-out visitors, an «I am on the team» toggle on the pages. It depends on G01 (user id in events) to tie the flag to the account; it touches the product beacon, so it goes through a PR.
